annotations.title: Write a month of video ideas

description: Start a content calendar, for "a month of posts about X": count faceless videos (1-31) over days (7-31), each with a title, hook, exact script, caption, hashtags and posting time. Send your own ideas as items, or Clypmint writes them (call again with the same operation_id if it says to). Makes and spends nothing: answers plan_id, the ideas and the quote; change ideas with edit_content_plan. After their yes, make them with create_videos (10 a call). Cost: Free to write; making each video costs about 4 credits (30 s).

count.description: How many videos (1-31); leave out when sending items.

instructions.description: Anything else about the calendar, in the user's words.

items.description: Ideas you wrote yourself (title, hook, script, caption, hashtags): taken as written, at once. Without them Clypmint writes the ideas.
One word, letters, digits or _, with or without #.

script.description: The exact words the narrator reads, about 2.5 words a second of video.

platforms.description: Where each post goes; Instagram when left out.

start_at.description: The first day; tomorrow when left out.

style_id.description: For every video: only one they named or their own (get_profile own_styles).

timezone.description: The IANA time zone of the posting times, e.g. America/Chicago.

voice.description: The narrator (sarah: calm, health and money; alice: clear British educator; brian: deep documentary; liam: energetic ads). Left out: one that fits.

name: plan_content

outputSchema.description: Clypmint plan_content result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Write a month of video ideas
